## What happens

This contract runs Lendroid's v1 lending code: a loan opens only with its lender's or borrower's signed offer and an approved wrangler's signature, and offers are cancelled by signature. Its check gives the recovery a fixed 3,000 gas, so under EIP-8151 opening and cancelling always revert.

## Evidence

- The [bytecode](https://etherscan.io/address/0x35042608a9a7b7e3973f4e028da3394cf1e7d35c#code) gives the recovery precompile a constant 3,000 gas and returns no signer when that call fails.
- In the [bytecode](https://etherscan.io/address/0x35042608a9a7b7e3973f4e028da3394cf1e7d35c#code), closing or liquidating a loan and the owner's token escape hatch never call the signature check.
- At block 26,438,999 the [contract](https://etherscan.io/address/0x35042608a9a7b7e3973f4e028da3394cf1e7d35c#code) accepts a valid signature, has never opened a loan, and holds no ETH or LST.

## Reviewer notes

### Mechanism

Unverified Vyper code; its selectors (fill_kernel, cancel_kernel, open_position, close_position, escape_hatch_token, ...) match Lendroid's published protocol.v.py (v1). ecrecover_from_signature (0xd241f7b3) does CALL(3000, 0x01) at 0x2b0, pops the success flag and returns mload(0xc0); a failed call leaves 0xc0 at zero, so it returns address 0. is_signer (0x20018b84) compares that with the prover, then retries with the signed-message prefix. fill_kernel (0x0ed405f7) requires lender, borrower and wrangler nonzero, checks is_signer(creator = borrower, or lender if the flag is set, kernel hash) and reverts on false, then self-calls open_position (0x7ed1a2ff, self-only), which requires wranglers[wrangler] (owner-set) and reverts unless is_signer(wrangler, position hash). cancel_kernel (0x7dafecd8) reverts unless is_signer(msg.sender, kernel hash). Under EIP-8151 a successful recovery costs 3,200 or 6,100 gas, so the 3,000-gas call fails, every prover (never zero) mismatches, and these three revert for everyone. Funds: open_position pulls the borrower's collateral into the contract. close_position (borrower, before expiry) and liquidate_position (lender or wrangler, after expiry) pay it out with no signature, using only the private lock, unlock and remove_position; escape_hatch_token lets the owner (a live EOA) take any token balance. After activation no new position can open, so nothing new comes in.

### Checks

- Header facts: this address alone, at block 26,438,999.
- Ruled out: ERC-1271 or a second path: no isValidSignature selector; the only call to 0x01 is the fixed-gas one; is_signer is a plain equality, raw and prefixed.
- Ruled out: a wrong verdict: a failed recovery reads as address 0 and every prover is nonzero (lender, borrower, wrangler asserted; cancel uses msg.sender), so checks fail closed.
- Ruled out: locked funds: close, liquidate and the owner's escape hatch contain no is_signer call; rated by that path, not by today's empty balance.
- Ruled out: a fix in place: no proxy slot, no upgrade function; the owner only toggles wranglers, tokens and the position threshold.
- Ruled out: replays: none in the dossier and no loan was ever opened (last_position_index 0), so no real transaction to replay.
- Ruled out: project: the code matches Lendroid's source and its token is the Lendroid Support Token, but no check shows who deployed this copy; left empty.
- Ruled out: not read: which wranglers and tokens are enabled (keys unknown, no log scans); it does not change the verdict.
